Name: 🍅 Ketchup
How It Works: Buy this to earn +1 Aura every second automatically. Buy it again and again to keep stacking more free Aura!

Name: 🥗 Sus Ranch
How It Works: Gives you +15 Aura every second automatically. Way more powerful than Ketchup!

Name: 🌶️ Szechuan Synergy
How It Works: Every single click on the nugget earns +10 extra Aura on top of your normal amount. The more you click, the more it pays off!

Name: 👿 Grimace Extract
How It Works: Automatically drips +200 Aura into your wallet every second. Costs a ton but earns a ton!

Name: 💎 Sigma Ohio Rizz Glaze
How It Works: Makes every bit of Aura you earn 50% bigger permanently. Buy it again for another +50% boost each time!

Name: 🌽 Ohio Boss
How It Works: +50% to all Aura earnings — but the Skibidi Toilet boss spawns 50% more often. High reward, high chaos. BONUS: every time you defeat the Skibidi Toilet while in Ohio, it drops 5 Kek Koins! More bosses = more coin income.

Name: 🗿 Sigma Slam
How It Works: +80% to all Aura earnings — the highest multiplier of any field card. Catch: all auto-collect effects are disabled. You must click everything yourself.

Name: 🌈 Nyan Cat
How It Works: +30% to all Aura earnings plus a coin trail spawns automatically every 30 seconds for free Aura. Lower multiplier than other fields — but the passive income never stops. Rainbow cursor trail included!

Name: 🪔 Moth and Lamp
How It Works: +65% to all Aura earnings — but the nugget is only visible when your cursor is within 120px of it. Stay close to the lamp!

Name: 🔥 This is Fine
How It Works: Sets the background on fire and speeds animations up by 30%, but only boosts earnings by 25%.

Name: 🍌 Peanut Butter Jelly
How It Works: Dancing banana time! Boosts all earnings by 40% AND doubles how often new cards appear. PLUS every Kek Koin that pops out of the nugget spawns a free bonus one automatically!

Name: 🧅 Shrek
How It Works: While Shrek is in your binder, ALL Aura you earn is 5% bigger AND the Skibidi Toilet steals 10% less Aura from you. Get out of my swamp!

Name: 🦍 Harambe
How It Works: Dicks out for Harambe! While slotted, Kek Koins appear every 22 clicks instead of the usual 30 — AND every click earns +0.5 flat Aura on top of your normal amount. Coins AND Aura. RIP.

Name: 📈 Stonks
How It Works: Every 90 seconds a bonus drop appears — click it to collect 75 Aura (scaled to your progress). Number go up, but only if you click!

Name: 🦖 Philosoraptor
How It Works: Every 90 seconds a floating question mark drifts across the screen. Hover your mouse over it to grab 3 Kek Koins — not Aura, actual coins for packs! If a nugget earns Kek Koins and no one collects them, do they still count?

Name: 🐕 Doge
How It Works: Every 60 seconds, Doge automatically drops a bonus worth 30 Aura (scaled to your progress) into your stash.

Name: 😢 First World Problems
How It Works: Stop clicking for 5 seconds and you enter AFK mode — you earn 1.5x your normal Aura-per-second income until you click again. Great if you need to step away!

Name: 😾 Grumpy Cat
How It Works: Always gives you +3% to all Aura earned AND makes every upgrade cost 10% less. PLUS every booster pack costs 2 fewer Kek Koins. Even after you've bought every upgrade, the pack discount never goes away. No.

Name: 👶 Success Kid
How It Works: Gives +1% to all Aura earned for every unique card type you own (up to +10%) PLUS better pack odds. BONUS: the more unique cards you own, the cheaper packs get — up to 5 Kek Koins off each pack. Grows with your collection!

Name: 🐰 Big Chungus
How It Works: Makes your nugget 1.5x bigger on screen AND every click earns 5% more Aura. The bigger size also improves click detection on precision and chase events — easier to hit tiny or moving targets!

Name: 🙂 Hide the Pain Harold
How It Works: Always gives +3% to all Aura earned, AND when the Skibidi Toilet attacks it steals 20% less from you. I'm fine.

Name: 🍔 I Can Has Cheezburger
How It Works: Every 60 seconds a cheeseburger floats across the screen — click it for 120 Aura (scaled to your progress). If you also have Doge slotted at the same time, the payout doubles to 240 Aura!

Name: 🧠 Expanding Brain
How It Works: Every minute you keep playing, your clicks earn 1% more Aura — and it never stops stacking! The longer your session, the more powerful it gets.

Name: 🥋 Chuck Norris
How It Works: Every 10th click is a super crit that earns 10 times your normal click amount. Keep clicking to charge it up!

Name: 🐸 Pepe
How It Works: Every 30 seconds Pepe's mood changes in a cycle: first +20% Aura per second, then +20% click power, then +10% to all Aura earned — then it repeats forever!

Name: 🗿 GigaChad
How It Works: Turns the screen grayscale and gives you +20% more Aura per second all the time.

Name: 😈 Troll Face
How It Works: The nugget starts dodging around the screen! Chase it and click it within 5 seconds to win a bonus worth 45 Aura (scaled to your progress).

Name: 🦋 Is This a Pigeon?
How It Works: 6 butterflies drift in wiggly, unpredictable sine waves for 4 seconds. They're hard to track — click them all for about 45 Aura total (scaled to your progress)!

Name: 🕷️ Spiderman Pointing
How It Works: Two Spidermen point at each other — and every Kek Koin currently on screen gets scooped up automatically! Then they auto-click the nugget 10 times at 1.5x your normal click value. Great for cleaning up loose coins.

Name: 👀 Distracted Boyfriend
How It Works: For 8 seconds, every time YOU click anything, a second ghost click appears 150px away. Amazing when coins or targets are raining — it doubles your reach!

Name: 🧽 Mocking SpongeBob
How It Works: AlTeRnAtInG cAsE engaged! Activating SpongeBob makes your next 5 Kek Koins worth DOUBLE each. Hold multiple copies and activate ALL at once — each extra copy doubles even more coins!

Name: 😬 Bad Luck Brian
How It Works: Typical Bad Luck Brian... this time he drops 2 Kek Koins onto the screen! Collect them fast. Hold multiple copies and use them ALL at once — the payout goes exponential! (1 copy: 2 coins · 2 copies: 6 coins · 3 copies: 14 coins)

Name: 🤡 Epic Fail Guy
How It Works: The nugget faceplants and you instantly receive Aura equal to 30 seconds of your Aura-per-second income.

Name: 👶 Charlie Bit My Finger
How It Works: Your Aura-per-second is multiplied by 1.5x for 20 seconds. Ow Charlie that really hurt!

Name: 💭 Have You Ever Had A Dream
How It Works: Your Aura-per-second is 1.5x for 20 seconds AND the Skibidi Toilet boss is frozen and can't attack during that time.

Name: 🎺 Kazoo Kid
How It Works: 10 coins fall with heavy gravity — they start slow then accelerate fast! Catch them before they hit the bottom to collect about 45 Aura total (scaled to your progress).

Name: ⚔️ Star Wars Kid
How It Works: Every click earns 2x Aura for 15 seconds. Strike them down!

Name: 🎤 Vitas
How It Works: Ghost clicks pierce the Skibidi Toilet's armor — 12 hits at 2.5x your normal click value that work even when the boss is blocking. The only Common that fights through a boss!

Name: 🍝 Pink Guy Ravioli
How It Works: 8 ravioli splat instantly across the screen and fade out in just 1.5 seconds — pure reaction speed! Click them all before they vanish for about 45 Aura total (scaled to your progress).

Name: 🐹 Dramatic Chipmunk
How It Works: DUN DUN DUN! Every click earns 5x Aura for 5 intense seconds.

Name: 🔥 Disaster Girl
How It Works: A sweep of fire scrolls across the screen over 4 seconds, collecting the nugget AND catching any nearby coins or targets within 150px of the sweep. 10 hits at 3x value!

Name: 😵 David After Dentist
How It Works: The screen goes blurry and the nugget grows huge for 6 seconds — the longest and most annoying gag. Sit through it and collect the biggest pity payout of 55 Aura (scaled to your progress).

Name: 📚 Ermahgerd
How It Works: ERMAHGERD! Starts at 15 seconds of Aura income — but mash the nugget during the 3-second window and each click adds +3 more seconds, up to 60 seconds max!

Name: 👾 All Your Base
How It Works: All your base are belong to us! Pays out based on how many times you clicked in the last 30 seconds times your click value. Minimum 30 seconds of income, maximum 60 seconds — so active players get more but can't go infinite.

Name: 📯 MLG Airhorn
How It Works: 360 NO-SCOPE! Screen shakes hard and you instantly earn Aura equal to 120 seconds of your Aura-per-second income!

Name: 👊 Arthur Fist
How It Works: Instant Aura equal to 120 seconds of your income, PLUS your very next click is worth double the normal amount. PLUS the fist pounds out 2 Kek Koins every time you use it!

Name: 🔴 Ugandan Knuckles
How It Works: 8 Knuckles swarm the screen! Click all of them within 10 seconds to earn a bonus worth 180 Aura (scaled to your progress).

Name: 😾 Woman Yelling at Cat
How It Works: The target flips between the left and right side of the screen — click the correct side 4 times within 10 seconds to earn up to 6x the payout!

Name: 😭 Leave Britney Alone
How It Works: A moving target with 8 HP drifts around the screen — you have to chase AND click it 8 times within 6 seconds to earn 180 Aura (scaled to your progress). She won't hold still!

Name: 🍇 Surgery on a Grape
How It Works: The nugget shrinks tiny! Land clicks on the tiny nugget for 10 seconds — each hit earns 5x your normal click value.

Name: 🍫 Chocolate Rain
How It Works: 20 chocolate drops fall straight down for 8 seconds — but every 4th drop is a golden Kek Koin worth 1 coin instead of Aura! The other 15 give Aura as normal. Click fast — you want both!

Name: 🐢 Zombie Kid Turtle
How It Works: A turtle with 5 HP crawls onto the screen — but if you stop clicking for 1.5 seconds, it regains 1 HP! Keep clicking without pausing to crack the shell and earn 8 Kek Koins. Don't let it regen!

Name: 🎹 Keyboard Cat
How It Works: Click 5 ascending zones on the screen — each hit must land higher than the last, like climbing a staircase. Get all 5 right within 8 seconds for up to 6x the payout!

Name: 💃 Numa Numa Dance
How It Works: A glowing pulse beats on screen like a metronome — click in time with each of the 6 beats within 10 seconds to earn up to 5x the Aura payout. It's all about timing!

Name: 🌠 Shooting Stars
How It Works: 15 neon stars streak fast across the screen from left to right for 8 seconds. Track the horizontal movement and click them all for about 180 Aura total (scaled to your progress)!

Name: 🕺 Rickroll
How It Works: Never gonna give you up! Your Aura-per-second triples (3x) for a full 60 seconds. It also pretends to crash first as a prank.

Name: 🐕 Gabe the Dog
How It Works: Bork bork! 25 bones fly across the screen for 10 seconds. Catch them ALL to earn 10 Kek Koins — way more useful than a click buff! Hold multiple copies and burn them all at once for exponential Koin rewards!

Name: 💪 John Cena
How It Works: YOU CAN'T SEE ME! The nugget turns completely invisible for 15 seconds — click where you think it is and each hit earns 7x your normal click value. Hardest precision card, highest mult!

Name: 🎯 Just Do It (Shia)
How It Works: JUST DO IT! The beat starts slow then gets faster and faster — hit all 8 beats as it accelerates within 12 seconds to build up to a massive 10x payout. The hardest rhythm card!

Name: 🛡️ Leroy Jenkins
How It Works: LEEEEROY! A target appears but you only have 3 seconds to click it. If you do, you earn a massive 900 Aura (scaled to your progress)!

Name: 😂 El Risitas
How It Works: JA JA JA! Normally banks 600 seconds of income instantly — but hold 2 copies and burn both at once for 1800 seconds, or 3 copies for a colossal 4200 seconds! The laughs scale up exponentially!

Name: ☄️ End of Ze World
How It Works: AMERICA!! Click 25 missiles flying across the screen in 15 seconds for 900 Aura total. Click EVERY SINGLE ONE and you also earn 10 Kek Koins as a bonus for the perfect run!

Name: 😍 Overly Attached GF
How It Works: She's watching closely! Only clicks directly on the nugget's center count for 15 seconds — but each perfect hit earns 6x your normal click value AND drops 1 Kek Koin. She rewards precision.

Name: 🐸 Evil Kermit
How It Works: Do it. Flip a coin: win Aura equal to 1800 seconds of your income, or walk away with nothing. 50/50 gamble — but the average payout beats playing it safe with El Risitas!
